scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && uv run --directory services/api --locked ruff check --config pyproject.toml . ../../tests
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter web format:check && uv run --directory services/api --locked ruff format --check --config pyproject.toml . ../../tests
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && uv run --directory services/api --locked ruff format --config pyproject.toml . ../../tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && uv run --directory services/api --locked mypy app tests ../../tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:infra && uv run --directory services/api --locked pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm api:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:web
